thread:
Ana: Quick jam — need to lock GTM priorities for next quarter. Three asks on the table: 1) PLG onboarding experiments (self-serve funnels), 2) Sales enablement pack for dedicated offering, 3) Paid model launch gating (pricing + SLA). Limited infra cycle next sprint, so scope tradeoffs required. Thoughts?
Jordan: Thanks — can we pick a single north-star metric per initiative? e.g., PLG = activation conversion, Enablement = sales velocity, Paid launch = revenue from pilot accounts. Also what are the sales targets we’re tracking to? :eyes:
Mike: For PLG experiments I propose a small scoped funnel change + one friction removal: in-product usage tips + trial credits. Hypothesis: +15% activation in 30 days. Keep it to one experiment at a time so infra impact is minimal.
Sophia: From AE side — enablement needs: 1-pager playbook, two product demos (technical + exec), and a competitive battlecard. Suggest we pilot enablement with top 5 accounts for 3 weeks before org-wide. If paid launch is gated, we need a beta cohort of 8 accounts and agreement on uplift targets.
Taylor: Docs/devex can spin up the playbook + demo scripts in 1.5 sprints if content is concise. We’ll need SMEs for walkthrough videos — can we get 4hrs / week from eng for two weeks?
Lisa: Ops note — infra team has only one infra sprint available (capacity 30%) next quarter. If PLG experiment requires model variant rollout we’ll need to queue it. Suggest we plan batching/caching adjustments instead of full model changes to reduce risk.
Jordan: Proposal: use a simple priority matrix (impact x effort). Quick wins: PLG funnel tweaks (high impact, low effort), Playbook (high impact, medium effort), Paid model launch (high impact, high effort). Can everyone score each initiative 1-5 by EOD?
Ana: Good matrix. Launch criteria draft: PLG = +10% activation OR +20% trial-to-paid lift in experiment with p<0.05. Enablement = 2 closed deals citing playbook material + demo NPS >= 8. Paid launch = pilot revenue >= $75k ARR across beta accounts AND latency SLO met 95% of requests <200ms. If criteria not met, fallback to extended pilot.
Mike: For PLG A/B tests: keep sample sizes small initially but statistically powered — will share sample calc. Also propose kill/sustain rules: 2-week early stop for negative delta >5%.
Taylor: Timeline ask — if we start next Monday: PLG experiment draft by Wed, demo/scripts by next Friday, beta list to Sophia by same Friday. Owners: Mike (PLG), Taylor (enablement doc), Sophia (sales pilot), Lisa (ops gate), Ana (overall). Is everyone OK?
Sophia: Works for me. I’ll pull beta accounts and legal contacts for pilot agreements.
Lisa: OK, I’ll reserve infra capacity and document fallback routes (model variant fallback to older quantized model).
Jordan: Scoring done — sent matrix in thread: PLG=4, Enablement=3, Paid launch=2 (effort high). Will add to roadmap board after we confirm owners.
pm-bot: Added card to Roadmap board: "QX GTM Prioritization — PLG / Enablement / Paid pilot" with owners assigned. :white_check_mark:
Ana: Thanks everyone — I’ll compile the notes and update the roadmap doc and OKRs. Follow-ups: Mike to post A/B sample calc, Taylor to drop demo scripts, Sophia to share beta account list. Quick status check next Wednesday 10am PT. :thumbsup:
